description: Detect the technologies behind a website: framework (Next.js, Nuxt, Astro, React...), site builder (Webflow, Framer, Lovable, Shopify, WordPress...), hosting/CDN (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare...), CSS (Tailwind, Bootstrap), analytics, payments, auth and support tools, with evidence. Fast (1-3 s). Free: 20 calls/day per user across free tools, no payment needed. Above that: $0.005 per call, with card credits (access_key) or x402.

access_key.description: Prepaid credit key (cs_live_...) bought by card at https://www.aypiai.online/credits. Works on every tool; each call deducts its price.

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.
